name: Consecrated Beamhead
description: Salute the door with the ram held upright, then lower it to a two-handed grip with the elbows tucked in.

name: Soundless Ramhorn
description: Advance on the balls of the feet with the head level, closing on the door as a hawk closes on prey.

name: Vigorbeam
description: Tap the lock-plate twice in quick succession to loosen the bolt before the main blow.

name: Pall Ramtail
description: Turn a spear aside with the ram's flank and return the cap into the thrower's guard.

name: Millstone Pounddown
description: Lean the ram against the door's bar and hold, binding it to its brackets so defenders cannot lift it.

name: Squall Smitedown
description: Walk the ram along the door's edge from lower hinge to upper, striking each pin as it passes.

name: Beamcrown
description: Drive the cap at the hinge side with qi gathered to a fine point, tearing the leaf from its pins.

name: Endknob Vow
description: Catch a defender's door-shove on the ram and return it through the beam, throwing him backward.

name: Thunderclap Pounddown
description: Cross the last few paces in a flicker of qi and land the ram's cap on the lock before the bar can be set.

name: Sovereign Radiance Swayswing
description: Bring the court's two lines of breath and strength together into the school's closing drive, taught as its finishing stroke.

name: Revered Slingchain
description: Lower into a crouch whose curve matches the basin, the beam braced across both thighs.

name: Deluge Hammerin
description: Pace the approach to a gate in even steps, counting them to a fixed length.

name: Peal Ramcap
description: Look along the gatepost to find whether the gate hangs true or sags toward one hinge.

name: Inferno Beamdrive
description: Roll the beam in a low arc beneath the gate's bottom rail to strike the sill's upward edge.

name: Devout Ramhorn
description: Wash an incoming blow past the ram's flank like water round a stone and turn the cap back.

name: Noble Shudder
description: Press on the sagging corner of a gate until the leaf drags on the ground and the bar slides free.

name: Luminous Bandring
description: Reset the crew's breath in the basin crouch after a failed blow, qi pooling again in the hips.

name: Ramverdict
description: Collapse the beam's weight onto a gate's lower hinge so the leaf drops from its pins.

name: Haemalbough
description: Surge through a rhythmic flood of blows that wears the gate's bar and braces down together.

name: Prismbeam
description: Let the crew's gathered qi rise like a basin brimming over and loose it as a breach that floods the gateway clear.

name: Valiant Prism Wheelbase
description: Fill the beam to the brim with the crew's gathered qi and let the school's stroke spill over the gate in one blow.

name: Rooted Carryhandle
description: Stand beneath the twin-peaked roof frame with the knees bent and the haul ropes held low.

name: Ramodyssey
description: Place each foot with care along the frame's floor planks so the carriage never rocks.

name: Carryhandle Mercy
description: Take up the slack in a haul rope with a quick hand-over-hand pull and a flash of qi.

name: Revelation Wheelbase
description: Knock on the roof's beams and listen for the dull note of a cracked rafter.

name: Haemalram
description: Swing the frame's two rams in alternating arcs so the door has no steady moment.

name: Smitedown Solace
description: Slip along the frame's flank to the sheltered side as a volley arrives.

name: Revered Headcap
description: Beat out burning scraps on the roof with a wet hide and a pulse of qi before they spread.

name: Faithful Ramcap
description: Brace both peaks of the roof with the crew's backs and push upward with qi when a stone drops.

name: Boughedict
description: Hammer the door under the roof's cover with both rams, one stroke after the other, until the bar bows.

name: Spectral Hammerin
description: Walk both frames forward under their joined roof, the qi of both crews holding the covering firm.

name: Magnificent Pounddown
description: Draw both rams back while the crews hold one breath, then loose them so door and frame cave inward.

name: Noble Pulsar Beamdrive
description: Join the two crews into one breath and loose the school's joined drive through the door and beyond.

name: Parity Ramhorn
description: Raise the beam's head in a smooth rising lift, the arms opening like a hawk lifting its wings.

name: Eclipse Beamhead
description: Stand on a step or cart-bed and scan the doorway and rooftops before the crew advances.

name: Haemal Swayswing
description: Thrust upward and forward, aiming the cap at the underside of a lintel or portcullis.

name: Enshrined Slingchain
description: Spin the beam over the head to deflect a dropped stone and carry on into the next stride.

name: Venomlog
description: Hook the iron collar under a door's bar and lift sharply, jerking it from its brackets.

name: Bedrock Smitedown
description: Pivot the beam on the toes with its weight carried by qi so it seems to float.

name: Vacuum Shudder
description: Drive the cap up into the lintel so the frame's crown cracks and the door below hangs loose.

name: Feather Hammerin
description: Advance up a ramp or stair with the beam held high, the crew pushing from below.

name: Ramvoyage
description: Rise in a swift bound of qi onto the threshold and drive the cap through the door's upper panel.

name: Prismlog
description: Gather the crew's qi upward through the beam like a hawk climbing on warm air and loose the school's rising stroke.

name: Faithful Endknob
description: Take the paired stance of two heavy rams hung side by side, the crew braced between them.

name: Hospitable Bandring
description: Haul both rams back to the same height with the same count, matching their arcs.

name: Clement Wheelbase
description: Read the two rams' relative weights through the ropes and adjust the crew's pulling.

name: Vigorram
description: Let one ram fall as the other rises, so the door takes a ceaseless alternation of heavy blows.

name: Immaculate Headcap
description: Cross the two hung rams in the path of a charging foe to turn him aside.

name: Vigor Smitedown
description: Slip free from a tangled chain by releasing one ram and stepping behind the other.

name: Solar Beamhead
description: Balance the two rams' pull on the frame with qi so the carriage never tilts.

name: Swayswing Verdict
description: Release both heavy rams at the door's two weakest points so it gives along both lines.

name: Gloomlog
description: Press both rams against the door's face and push the frame forward to fold the leaves.

name: Logbanner
description: Draw the heavy pair back together, gather the crews' qi into one point and loose both rams to shatter the entry.

name: Steel Ramtail
description: Drop the paired rams in the school's finishing fall, two weights landing as one on the door.

name: Statute Endknob
description: Stand with the poise of a perched hawk and the rootedness of a river's bank.

name: Squallbough
description: Carry the beam along the flat of a river bank, the feet finding the pebbles by feel.

name: Ramhorn Benison
description: Scan the door from a distance, picking out the hinge pins and the lock's seat.

name: Reminiscence Headcap
description: Touch the cap to the door and read how its shaking runs, as a swimmer reads a current.

name: Quenched Shudder
description: Swoop in low and strike the door's lowest plank, rising before the defenders can reply.

name: Skyborne Pounddown
description: Split the crew into two arms around an obstacle like a river forking round a rock.

name: Unbending Beamdrive
description: Hold the beam still against the door with the crew's weight and qi settled like a river in its bed.

name: Volition Slingchain
description: Cascade the crew's qi down the haul rope in steps, each bearer's pull adding to the last.

name: Beambanner
description: Plunge from above and follow with a surge that carries the cap through door and bar.

name: Windborne Beamdrive
description: Widen the crew's line like a river's mouth as it passes the breach, sweeping defenders from both sides.

name: Feather Swayswing
description: Blink in a single burst of qi to the door and drive the cap through it with a river's weight.

name: Storied Steel Bandring
description: Unite the hawk's swift fall and the river's deep weight into the school's one breaching stroke.

name: Devout Ramtail
description: Take the hand ram in both fists and speak the grip's oath so the hold does not loosen.

name: Delugebough
description: Walk into the wind with the ram held low, head bowed and shoulders settled.

name: Interstice Carryhandle
description: Listen for the whistle of wind through a latch gap and aim the cap at its source.

name: Bedrock Beamdrive
description: Strike each hinge pin once for each word of the oath until the pins give.

name: Parity Bandring
description: Step with a gust to avoid a defender's thrust through the gap beside the door.

name: Gloombeam
description: Lean the ram into the door and speak the oath aloud, pressing until the bar groans.

name: Logvoyage
description: Step back to the taken bearing after a parried blow and set the grip again.

name: Beamdecree
description: Drive the cap into the hinge side with the oath's last word, bursting the pins from the frame.

name: Ramcrown
description: Surge through the door's opening in the gale's wake, the ram sweeping the passage clear.

name: Vacuum Smitedown
description: Speak the oath's last verse, gather qi into the cap, and loose a stroke that bursts the door inward.

name: Storied Shudder Crown
description: Gather the oath and the wind into one blow the school teaches as the sworn finishing stroke of the hand ram.

name: Faithful Beamhead
description: Crouch low behind the hand ram as the plateau wind scours over the crew.

name: Hammerin Boon
description: Step flat-footed over frosted turf so the soles grip and the carry stays level.

name: Bloom Headcap
description: Rub qi into the palms and fingers to keep the grip supple on the cold haft.

name: Evanescent Pounddown
description: Run the plateau's rim with the ram held low and strike before the defenders hear the wind change.

name: Peal Slingchain
description: Turn a charging foe along the rim with the ram's flank so he stumbles toward the drop.

name: Phantasm Ramhorn
description: Kick up dust on the rim so it blows across defenders' eyes while the crew closes.

name: Peerless Pounddown
description: Drive the cap into the door as a gust crests the rim, splitting planks and tearing bolts.

name: Season Ramcap
description: Run the crew over the open rim into the door, keeping pressure on it until the bar gives.

name: Soundless Endknob
description: Blink along the rim on a burst of qi and send the ram's head through the door at the run's end.

name: Pulsar Swayswing
description: Gather the plateau's wind and cold into the ram and loose the school's closing blow at the door.

name: Magnanimous Carryhandle
description: Stand still for three breaths and take the bearing on the door by two marks.

name: Pounddown Grace
description: Carry the beam in step with the oath count, each syllable a pace.

name: Ramtail Vow
description: Keep the eyes on the taken mark and the beam before the body as a guard.

name: Undaunted Wheelbase
description: Hold the haft plumb so the cap points at the mark however the wind pushes.

name: Ramcap Decree
description: Strike on the oath's last word, the crew's qi reaching the cap along the bearing.

name: Ethereal Hammerin
description: Shift to a second mark when a foe blocks the first, turning his strike aside as the line moves.

name: Gloomramcap
description: Press the ram against the door and hold the oath count until the leaves bind to their frame.

name: Bandring Blessing
description: Call the bearing back mid-run so the crew's line straightens and no strike falls wide.

name: Pulsarram
description: Strike the marked point on the oath's last word with qi gathered along the bearing.

name: Wraithlike Shudder
description: Sweep the sworn line through the breach on a held bearing, clearing both sides of the entry.

name: Ramboon
description: Cross the last paces on the taken bearing in a blink of qi and land the cap on the mark.

name: Heroic Headcap Verdict
description: Bind bearing and oath into the one drive the school teaches as its finishing blow on a marked door.

name: Venerable Ramcap
description: Brace the beam in open ground with the feet wide and the knees soft.

name: Beamboon
description: Lean into the open sky's wind and step with the crew in an easy, ranging pace.

name: Interstice Ramhorn
description: Read a door standing alone on open ground, noting how its frame is braced against the wind.

name: Windborne Hammerin
description: Run up from a long way back across open ground and release the beam on the last pace.

name: Stately Endknob
description: Crouch the crew behind the beam to shelter from thrown shot while qi warms stiff hands.

name: Logboon
description: Turn the crew's wide rank as one around a defender's flank, deflecting charges from the beam's side.

name: Serene Wheelbase
description: Let the free wind belly a hide sheet on the beam's back, easing the haul while qi steadies the grip.

name: Prism Shudder
description: Strike the lone door's frame with the whole run's weight, qi gathered, splitting the planks.

name: Logdecree
description: Swing the beam in a great arc across open ground, clearing defenders from the doorway's approach.

name: Beamgrace
description: Blink across open ground behind the beam and drive the cap into the door in the same breath.

name: Ramcapverdict
description: Gather open ground's wind and distance into the beam and loose the school's closing stroke on a lone door.

name: Revered Ramtail
description: Take the haul stance for a heavy ram with the gale in the crew's faces and the ropes drawn tight.

name: Twilit Beamdrive
description: Advance the heavy ram at a pace slowed by the gale, each step set down with weight.

name: Eclipse Slingchain
description: Listen to the haul rope's hum in the wind to learn when its weakest strand will part.

name: Thunderclap Carryhandle
description: Release the heavy ram on a gust's rise, the crew's qi flowing into the swing.

name: Deluge Slingchain
description: Snap the haul rope taut to turn aside a thrown beam and jar the foe's footing.

name: Venerable Beamhead
description: Settle the ram's weight into the crew's legs when a gust shoves the frame, qi bracing every knee.

name: Quenched Swayswing
description: Release the heavy ram into the door at a gale's crest, wind and weight shearing bar and braces.

name: Seasonbough
description: Push the heavy ram forward with the gale behind it, the door bowing under steady pressure.

name: Radiance Beamdrive
description: Gather the crew's qi through the rope into the heavy ram as the gale peaks, then loose it on the door.

name: Boughtriumph
description: Bind the gale's weight and the crew's oath into the school's closing fall of the heavy ram.

name: Inviolate Ramcap
description: Set the feet to the sworn wind's direction and hold the beam braced across the chest.

name: Ramcapboon
description: Advance on the wind's count, every step landing as the gust passes.

name: Clement Ramtail
description: Read the shadow flickering behind a door's gap to learn how many hold the bar.

name: Bloom Bandring
description: Speak the oath as the crew lifts so every hand comes up on the same word.

name: Vigor Hammerin
description: Strike on the oath's last word, the wind carrying the sound and the crew's qi gathered at the cap.

name: Inviolate Carryhandle
description: Veer with a sudden wind shift to let a thrust pass and bring the beam round.

name: Entropy Beamdrive
description: Hook the haft's collar under the bar and heave on the oath's word until it lifts clear.

name: Unbending Shudder
description: Bind the crew's qi along the haul chain so the wind cannot pull their line apart.

name: Valiant Swayswing
description: Strike the door on the sworn wind's peak so the bar and brackets part in one blow.

name: Squallram
description: Sweep the crew's rank through the breach on the wind's push, clearing the entry of defenders.

name: Season Smitedown
description: Cross the last yards in a blink of qi on the wind's push and drive the cap through the door.

name: Matchless Endknob
description: Call the sworn wind into the beam and loose it as the school's closing stroke on a barred door.
